Connecticut alone would only double rent to $16 before houses are built. The real question is whether $120 is better kept as cash. Claude's three railroads cost $100 each. The opponent's scattered properties currently pay low rent. GPT's Boardwalk pays $50.

I can mortgage my B&O Railroad for $100 if I need extra cash. I will not auction Connecticut Avenue because other players might outbid me.
